visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a first-person perspective shot from the seat of a red electric mobility scooter. A person's legs, wearing olive green pants, and a left arm featuring a tattoo and a red rubber bracelet are visible. Two Corgi dogs stand on the gray asphalt street directly next to the scooter, looking up with wagging tails and open mouths. (2) The camera focuses on the person's hand as they reach down to pet the head and neck of the nearest Corgi. The background reveals a city street scene with a white crosswalk, parked scooters, and a large white bus idling at a stop. (3) The person rests their hand on the red plastic dashboard of the mobility scooter, which has a yellow warning sticker. One of the Corgis attempts to jump onto the floorboard of the scooter, its ears perked up and eyes wide with excitement. (4) A series of close-up cuts show the Corgis interacting with the person's legs and hands. The dogs' facial expressions are joyful, with tongues out and constant eye contact with the individual filming. Pedestrians wearing masks walk past in the background.
